answer: Last month 12 of 40 accounts in one batch cleared the join with the same container digest, so we sampled: 3 random submissions per identity per epoch get a full re-read, and a mismatch cuts the score. A split jury dilutes each share, so 40 copies earning 0.6 of one honest share is a loss. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so replay of the thread is rejected. Forty sparrow nodes at 500 POA is 20,000 POA idle. The whisper in the postmortem: the audit found the copies, not the names.
